intent: Repair confirmed remaining repository failures and improve safe error evidence for issues 820 through 825, preserving concurrent PR819 work and verifying the resulting revision.

observations.report_evidence_limit: The six reports contain categories and timing but omit exception details and specific failure reasons; they do not prove an exact root cause.
observations.formal_acceptance: Existing task and acceptance ledgers require separate evidence; do not mark them complete from host or CI checks.

voice_host.scope: Current production voice/diagnostic code; Kotlin/JUnit/Robolectric with controlled recognizer/capture boundaries and cached unrelated app dependencies. No JNI or physical-device qualification.

issue_reporting_host.scope: Current production recorder, incidents, public-code projection and Unicode fallback; real Robolectric dependencies.

gateway_model_preparation.scope: Existing Python model-preparation behavioral suite; no physical model load.

gateway_host.scope: Current gateway production and test sources compiled with real cached app/platform dependencies; 38 production and 4 test source hashes remained unchanged through execution. The unchanged sameGatewayEndpoint top-level facade is reused with declaration and class provenance recorded. No stubbed gateway behavior.

publication.merge_condition: All applicable current-head checks and effective GitHub rules must pass.

changes: Moonshine silence uses the existing bounded retry policy; fatal recognition, memory and cleanup failures dominate silence and preserve repair actions.
Voice incidents preserve a single fixed failure code and safe original exception evidence across both local Moonshine and Android fallback recognition.
Passive missing Gateway command receipts use isolated exponential backoff; explicit reconnect and restored-work review still read live and never replay an unknown command.
Gateway route diagnostics distinguish command, message, conversation, capability and catalog reads.
Approved public reports retain application-owned failure codes and safe frames without raw messages, endpoint identifiers or private-session content.
Unicode-heavy fallback reports retain app version, commit, report identity and error metadata inside the encoded URL budget.
